newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bendigo Bank says on track to grow.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bendigo Bank says on track to grow.

text.p: Bendigo Bank Ltd was on track for a period of sustained growth following its conversion to bank status, chairman Richard Guy said late on Monday.
In his address to the annual general meeting, Guy said trading figures for the September quarter were ahead of the same period last year.
"Our conversion to bank status has already reaped benefits and has put our company on track for a period of sustained growth," he said.
"As expected, given our increased commitment to business banking, our commercial lending shows significant growth."
Guy said the bank expects business banking to contribute solidly to growth.
"Our commercial area has traditionally returned between six and nine percent of our lending activities," he said.
"We anticipate lifting that to around 15 percent during this financial year and growing this proportion gradually in subsequent years."
Bendigo Bank converted from a building society to a bank on July 1, 1995.
